name: Demo E4: Modeled Pipe Tee Branch Redline
description: Run one bounded disposable pipe branch redline through /revit/mep-branch-network-workflow and require dry-run proof, split main ids, branch and tee fitting model ids, visual gate, and cleanup evidence.
setup_instructions: Open the target Revit model and the sheet/view containing a smaller pipe branch redline into a main pipe.
Use a prepared deterministic request that creates a disposable main pipe from points, projects the branch point, creates the branch, verifies the tee fitting, and cleans up the created ids.
Use /revit/mep-branch-network-workflow with branchNetworkWorkflow=true, connectionMode=tee, apply=true, verify=true, and visualVerify=true; do not report completion from dry-run evidence alone.
success_criteria: /revit/mep-branch-network-workflow returns a dry-run preview before writes and an applied/created status after writes.
The result reports split main pipe ids, created branch pipe ids, and tee fitting ids.
The projected tap point is reported and matches the requested point within tolerance.
Requested branch pipe size is read back after the model write.
The branch-network workflow reports the created fitting ids needed for connector/topology audit.
A focused post-change capture is returned and the redline visual gate passes.
Created disposable branch/fitting ids are proven in a cleanup dry-run and then deleted after verification evidence is recorded.
failure_criteria: The workflow only dry-runs or returns no model write ids.
The projected tap point is missing or off target.
The requested branch pipe size readback is missing or mismatched.
No created tee fitting ids or branch-network audit evidence is reported.
The focused visual capture is missing.
The redline visual gate is fail or uncertain.
Cleanup is requested but created branch/fitting ids are missing from cleanup evidence.
grader_notes: This benchmark covers one safe disposable pipe tee branch-network case. It does not yet prove multi-pipe rack top taps, takeoff fittings, tee splitting across multiple mains, or arbitrary multi-branch routing.
optional_cleanup_steps: Delete created branch/fitting ids after visual verification so repeated live reliability runs do not accumulate model clutter.
